校园正成为新项目孵化场

subtitles.en: So there's this growing debate over whether college is still worth it in the age of AI.
subtitles.zh: 如今，关于大学在AI时代是否还值得读，争论日益升温。

subtitles.en: It's the technology friends to reshape entry-level jobs in particular, but on college campuses, there's another side to the story.
subtitles.zh: 这项技术尤其重塑了入门级工作，但在大学校园里，故事还有另一面。

subtitles.en: A kind of AI gold rush, fueling a new generation of student founders.
subtitles.zh: 一场AI淘金热，正催生新一代学生创业者。

subtitles.en: A Molly Fowler is the founding partner at dorm room fund, which backs students and recent graduates.
subtitles.zh: 莫莉·福勒是Dorm Room Fund的创始合伙人，该基金支持学生和应届毕业生。

subtitles.en: And in very simple terms, that is what you're doing.
subtitles.zh: 简单来说，这就是你们在做的事。

subtitles.en: You are finding the start-up or the idea.
subtitles.zh: 你们在寻找初创公司或创意。

subtitles.en: Maybe in some cases where the student is still on campus, still studying.
subtitles.zh: 有时学生还在校园里，还在读书。

subtitles.en: That's an interesting strategy. Explain how it works.
subtitles.zh: 这策略挺有意思。解释一下怎么运作。

subtitles.en: Yeah, sure thing, Ed. So this is not necessarily such a crazy idea as it used to be 14 years ago when we started.
subtitles.zh: 好的，Ed。14年前我们起步时，这想法还没现在这么疯狂。

subtitles.en: But dorm room funds thesis is that when there are massive technology shifts, it creates this really interesting environment where the sort of macro trends
subtitles.zh: 但Dorm Room Fund的核心理念是，当技术发生大规模变革时，会创造出非常有趣的环境，宏观趋势……

subtitles.en: privilege first-time builders and folks that are on campus.
subtitles.zh: 优先考虑首次创业者和校园里的人。

subtitles.en: Yes. It's sort of a result of the fact that if you think about it, university campuses are in a lot of ways the ultimate hacker house or accelerator.
subtitles.zh: 是的。这某种程度上是因为，大学校园在很多方面就是终极黑客空间或加速器。

subtitles.en: You know, it's a concentration of talent. They've got time to build.
subtitles.zh: 你知道，这里人才集中，他们有时间去构建。

subtitles.en: Teachers teaching them the cutting edges of the bleeding edge of technology.
subtitles.zh: 老师教他们最前沿的技术。

subtitles.en: And they've got a ton of just incredible humans around them to help them build.
subtitles.zh: 而且他们周围有很多了不起的人帮助他们构建。

subtitles.en: And so as we thought about this back in 2012, when the cloud compute revolution was new, we thought to ourselves, gosh, we need to find a really effective way to figure out who's great.
subtitles.zh: 所以当我们在2012年思考这个问题时，云计算革命刚刚兴起，我们想，天哪，我们需要找到一种真正有效的方法来找出谁很棒。

subtitles.en: And who might just be sort of feeling things out for a class project.
subtitles.zh: 以及谁可能只是在为课堂项目摸索。

results.snippet: There’s a clear “culture around starting companies” on numerous school campuses, says Molly Fowler, a founding partner of DRF, which spun off from First Round Capital in 2021 as its own independent fund. That culture is “hard to manufacture,” which is why funds like hers have found these resources so valuable to tap into. [...] The concept for Dorm Room Fund was conceived in 2012 by venture capitalist Josh Kopelman, the founder of First Round Capital. Kopelman noted that many major tech companies had been launched by college dropouts, or people in close proximity to university communities, including Facebook, Microsoft, and Google. [...] As Dorm Room Fund grows, Fowler says she’s focused on maintaining the firm’s unique culture. data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
